signal: Snappt raised a $100M Series A from Insight Partners and announced 2026 partnerships with CLEAR and TurboTenant to expand its fraud-detection and income-verification platform

email.body1:
Mack, saw Snappt land the $100M from Insight and line up CLEAR and TurboTenant partnerships to extend the fraud platform.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market property operators than your reps can cover, and good-fit accounts go cold before anyone reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Snappt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mack, quick follow-up for Snappt.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mack, last bit of proof for Snappt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Snappt's reply rate likely compares to other venture-backed startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mack, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a raise, and standing up new partnerships is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I'll tailor it to Snappt either way.
